annotation.summary: Append-only registry of rule saved-object model versions; released versions are frozen. Rule params in MAPPED_PARAMS_PROPERTIES (risk_score, severity) are also persisted, at write time, in the top-level mapped_params projection (severity as a sortable value via SEVERITY_MAP, e.g. '60-high').

risks.text: A model version added here that mutates a MAPPED_PARAMS_PROPERTIES param (risk_score, severity) changes a value that is also held in the stored mapped_params projection, which find/sort/filter reads in place of params; the write paths that keep the two consistent do not run during migration. Released versions are frozen — new behavior is appended as a new version.

invariants: The find path rewrites every sort field, search field, and KQL filter on params.risk_score / params.severity to mapped_params.* (find_rules.ts via mapped_params_utils.ts); for find/sort/filter the stored projection is the value read, not params.

mapped_params is (re)computed only by the rule create/update write paths (transform_rule_domain_to_rule_attributes). A migration transform rewrites the document without running them, and no path re-saves rules after an upgrade.
Every writer persists mapped_params == getMappedParams(params). A severity value absent from SEVERITY_MAP (any non-canonical case) projects to ''.
mapped_params is an existing attribute of the raw-rule saved-object schema (raw_rule/v1.ts), stored alongside params.
